summary: Iteration 3 – NutriVerse Healthcare Hub end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 40/40 pytest passed (12 new healthcare tests + 28 prior). Frontend: every required hub interaction verified — Home tile routes to /app/healthcare, Picker shows all 8 conditions with correct testids, Diabetes condition renders MEALS RECOMMENDED FOR + Diabetes label, search placeholder 'Search within diabetes…', meal-type tabs filter correctly (Breakfast → PCOS-Friendly Chia Overnight Oats), 15-min toggle filters cards (returns prep<=15), day-meal-plan view shows breakfast/lunch/dinner sections, recipe cards render health-score badges (diabetes safe, pcos friendly), nutritional tag chips (high-fibre, low-GI), italic 'Why it works' line, swaps card visible with Sugar→Dates entry, streak card shows '1 Day streak / 1 Meals this week / 1 Recipes tried' after logging a meal.

issues: Header reads 'MEALS RECOMMENDED FOR' (uppercase tracking) followed by the condition label on a new line, instead of the inline 'Meals Recommended For: <Label>' phrasing in the spec. Functionally equivalent and visually clean — no change needed unless product wants exact spec wording.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 689 lines and growing (healthcare router adds ~75) — split into routers/ package (auth, recipes, healthcare, nutrition, ai, lifestyle) for maintainability. Same comment as iteration-1.
GET /api/healthcare/recipes 'quick' filter falls back to cook_time when prep_minutes is missing — reasonable but EXTRA_RECIPES set both. Minor, no defect.
Healthcare endpoints conditions/recipes/swaps are public (correct per spec); only /streak gated by JWT — verified.
Old test_list_31_recipes was stale after adding hc-006..hc-012 (now 38 recipes). Updated assertion to >=31 so future seed additions don’t break it.
test_credentials: No pre-seeded users. Tests register fresh users with @nutri.example.com domain. Healthcare frontend test sets profile category=healthcare via API + injects JWT into localStorage (nv_token) to bypass onboarding for direct route access.
seed_data_creation: EXTRA_RECIPES (hc-006 Beetroot Smoothie, hc-007 Greek Yogurt+Walnuts, hc-008 Spinach+Egg, hc-009 Roasted Chickpea Crunch, hc-010 Lemon Ginger Tea, hc-011 Quinoa Tabbouleh, hc-012 Sweet Potato+Black Bean) verified merged via _apply_healthcare_enrichments() at module load. CONDITIONS list returns all 8 with non-zero recipe_count.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Healthcare hub fully passing. Auth flow: register → PUT /api/user/profile {onboarded:true, category:'healthcare'} → set localStorage 'nv_token' to bypass onboarding. Frontend localStorage key is 'nv_token'. Public healthcare endpoints: /api/healthcare/{conditions,recipes,swaps}; auth-only: /api/healthcare/streak. data-testids in Healthcare.jsx: condition-<id>, hc-search, hc-view-browse, hc-view-dayplan, hc-quick-toggle, hc-mealtype-tabs, hc-day-plan, hc-recipe-<id>, healthcare-streak, healthcare-swaps, hc-back, hc-change-condition. Recipe cards render 'Why it works:' italic line when why_this_works_for_condition is non-null.
